name: Strict TDD Enforcement
description: Turns GSD's advisory TDD gate into a blocking one. At execute:post, every type:tdd plan in the phase must have a RED commit (test(<phase>-<plan>)) that is an ancestor of its GREEN commit (feat(<phase>-<plan>)), otherwise the phase does not seal. A deliberate bypass requires a reason string and is appended to an in-repo receipt. Fires only at GSD loop extension points; it does not reach the tool-call boundary.
author: Ayoub Hidri <ayoub.hidri@gmail.com>
